_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fs3i#5, and a FALSIFICATION of the section it names. The entry told the reader to set ITEMAX in FS3I DYNAMIC. That section has no ITEMAX: writing one aborts at parse time in core/io/src/4C_io_input_spec_builders.cpp line 633 with 'Could not match this input' and the key listed under '[!] The following data remains unused:'. The real home is the FS3I DYNAMIC/PARTITIONED subsection, alongside COUPALGO and CONVTOL, and its ITEMAX already defaults to 10 — so the outer scalar loop is bounded whether or not it is set, contradicting the entry's 'lets the outer scalar coupling iterate indefinitely'. Written there on upstream fs3i_part_1wc_infperm.4C.yaml it is accepted and the deck still passes all three result tests. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, commit 89519cfe76).

_mutation.note: remove the wrong-placement pathology: stop writing ITEMAX into FS3I DYNAMIC. CLAIMED_ARM_HAS_ITEMAX drops to 0 (a forbidden token) and the parse abort vanishes, so the fixture must go red.

remove the correct-placement control: stop writing the FS3I DYNAMIC/PARTITIONED block. REAL_ARM_HAS_PARTITIONED_SECTION drops to 0 (a forbidden token), so the demonstration that the key belongs there is gone and the fixture must go red.
